blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A man who was released from detention in August after entering a plea bargain in a drug case was arrested again in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, after authorities seized 577.07 grams of suspected shabu worth nearly P4 million during a buy-bust operation. The 30-year-old suspect, identified only as alias “Bon,” was arrested at around 6:50 p.m. on Wednesday, October 28, in Purok 8, Barangay Cogon, according to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Central Visayas (PDEA-7).
